_about: Example TV Time Capsule configuration. Copy to ~/.config/tv-time-capsule/config.json and edit paths, mounts, and keys. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and are ignored by the app.

mounts._example: Samba / CIFS — password in OS keychain (see docs/usage/secrets.md)
Samba / CIFS — credentials file instead of keychain

youtube._about: DEFAULT: prefer_cache + cache.enabled (file when present, live Chrome on miss). Set playback_mode=live to force Chrome always; cached_only for Pi 1/Zero. See docs/usage/native-cached-defaults.md.

cache._about: Forever yt-dlp cache (local or NAS). DEFAULT enabled. directory null = first writable media_paths entry (else ~/.local/share/.../youtube-offline). Prefer fill on desktop then mount on weak Pis. max_bytes null = never delete. layout season_folders matches Show/s01/S01E01 - Title [id].mp4; flat omits the season folder. Press Y in browse to priority-cache the selected show/season/episode now. Set enabled=false to disable background fills (live still works).

home_menu._about: Top-level LIBRARY rows for parent vs kids. Defaults include weather. Tokens: shows, movies, weather, 1950s-2000s, directory, 001-003.

features._about: Master switches. false removes dial/UI entry and never starts Chrome for that feature.

weather._about: DEFAULT provider=native (custom pygame Retro Weather; no Chromium). Live screencast opt-in: twc (weather.com/retro) or ws4kp (WeatherStar 4000+). auto also resolves to native. Headless Pi has no GPS — set zip/city. latitude+longitude override zip/query when both are set. Default location: Boston, MA. See docs/usage/native-cached-defaults.md.
weather.name: Boston

screencast._about: Only used by live providers (twc/ws4kp). auto = adapt FPS/quality/resolution from CDP frame latency + UI present FPS/blit cost (and Linux loadavg). Oldest Pis may land at 1–2 FPS; Chromium is required for live. mode=fixed + target_fps for testing. WS4KP ignores auto and stays at ws4kp_target_fps (default 4) — only the clock needs frequent updates.

music._about: Background jazz (enabled) and page voiceovers (announcements_enabled) are independent. Set either false to mute that part only.

native._about: page_seconds = carousel dwell. Optional forecast_refresh_seconds (default 90), alert_refresh_seconds (default 90), forecast_loop_min_gap_seconds (default 45) override live re-fetch cadence — omit to keep built-in defaults. alert_style=marquee scrolls NWS alerts between the clock and logo.

maps._about: Native Radar page uses free NWS RIDGE regional loops (e.g. NORTHEAST_loop.gif) from radar.weather.gov/ridge/standard — no API key. Region is chosen from lat/lon (nearest mosaic); set region to override (NORTHEAST, CENTGRLAKES, SOUTHEAST, CONUS, …). Prefetched while Current is on screen; frames are smooth-scaled once to the panel size.

alerts._about: Lower-thirds marquee queue. Feeds are fetched together and merged (emergency → school → weather). type=nws is free api.weather.gov (weather + civil emergency event codes). type=flashalert is TV-station FlashAlert XML (url and/or local path from FTP). type=rss|atom is any school-board / EMA headline feed (set category=school|emergency|other). type=cap follows a CAP Atom/RSS index (e.g. after you register for FEMA IPAWS All-Hazards). Disable a feed with enabled:false.

retro_tv._about: MyRetroTVs decade streams (dial 1950-2009). DEFAULT playback_mode=cached (playlist oracle + 2-slot temp yt-dlp + ffmpeg). Set live for full Chrome CDP screencast. See docs/usage/native-cached-defaults.md. filters maps box_* checkbox ids; volume is 0-100.

youtube_channels._about: Virtual YouTube shows. playlist_shows unrolls selected playlists into shows (group seasons with match capture, e.g. Ghostwriter Season N). include_playlists keeps one channel show with only selected seasons. strip_title_prefix / title_deletions / title_substitutions normalize titles.

youtube_channels.title: Ms Rachel
title_deletions: (?i)\s*\|\s*(?:Videos for Toddlers|Toddler Learning Videos?|Educational Kids Videos|Kids Dance Songs|Speech(?: Delay Learning Video)?|Videos for Babies|Baby Videos|Videos for Kids)\s*$

youtube_channels.title: Raffi
title_deletions: (?i)\s*[-–—]\s*In Concert with the Rise and Shine Band\s*$

youtube_channels.title: Ms Moni
title_deletions: (?i)\s*\|\s*(?:Toddler Learning Videos?|Kids Learning Videos|Toddler Learning with Ms\.?\s*Moni|Learn To Talk with Ms\.?\s*Moni|Talking Toddler Learning|Learning For Toddlers|Construction Vehicles For Kids|Toddler Learning Videos,\s*Kids Songs\s*&\s*Nursery Rhymes Compilation|2hrs? Compilation)\s*$

_youtube_title_rules.about: Optional global youtube_title_rules as {deletions, substitutions} or a legacy [{pattern, replace, scope}] list. Omit for built-in defaults tuned to the kids/classic channel set; [] / empty object disables. Per-channel title_deletions / title_substitutions / strip_title_prefix run after these. Patterns are full Python regexes.

_channels.order: Show folder names in desired browse / priority order (unknown names skipped)
_channels.numbers: Optional fixed channel numbers; unlisted shows use 1-based position in the ordered lineup

_library.rescan_interval_seconds: Periodic rescan while idle on the show list (0 = off)
_library.rescan_long_press_ms: Hold R (reset key) this long to rescan without restarting

_kids_mode.default_enabled: Fallback when enabled is omitted — first launch only
_kids_mode.enabled: Persisted parent/kids mode (written when you toggle Tab); restored on next start
_kids_mode.allowlist: Omit for full kids library (legacy). Once present, kids mode only shows tagged shows/movies; parent K toggles tags

_home_menu.parent: Adult LIBRARY rows (default shows, movies, weather). Tokens: shows, movies, weather, 1950s-2000s, directory, 001-003
_home_menu.kids: Kids LIBRARY rows (same token set; defaults include weather). Digit easter-egg dials stay parent-only

_network.mdns_hostname: LAN browse name without .local — set by install.sh / install-pi.sh (--hostname)
_network.admin_port: Web admin TCP port; Avahi HTTP service uses this during install

_admin.bind: 0.0.0.0 for LAN phones; 127.0.0.1 for SSH tunnel only

_weather.zip: US ZIP / postal code (e.g. 10001). Resolved via weather.com location search.
_weather.query: Free-text city search when zip is unset (e.g. "Austin, TX").
_weather.name: Optional display name override for the location.
_weather.latitude: Optional; if set with longitude, used directly (overrides zip/query).
_weather.provider: DEFAULT native (custom pygame). Live opt-in: twc | ws4kp. auto → native
_weather.maps.enabled: Native Radar page on/off (default true; uses free NWS RIDGE regional loops, no API key)
_weather.maps.region: Optional mosaic id override (e.g. NORTHEAST, CENTGRLAKES); null = nearest from lat/lon
_weather.screencast.mode: Live providers only. auto | fixed — auto adapts FPS/quality from CDP latency + UI present FPS/blit
_weather.screencast.target_fps: When set (or mode=fixed), lock approximate FPS for testing
_weather.screencast.jpeg_quality: CDP JPEG quality 20–95 (default 80; auto may lower)

_features.weather: false removes dial 004 (default true). Native weather needs no Chromium; live twc/ws4kp do.
_features.retro_tv: false removes decade dials / MyRetroTVs (default true)
_features.youtube: false removes YouTube shows and catalog scrape (default true)

_retro_tv.playback_mode: DEFAULT cached = playlist oracle + 2-slot temp yt-dlp + ffmpeg; live = full Chrome screencast (opt-in)
_retro_tv.cache_directory: Temp root for cached mode (null = ~/.local/share/tv-time-capsule/retro-tv-cache/). Wiped when leaving Decades.
_retro_tv.filters: box_* checkbox map; null = site default until changed in Enter menu

_playback.autoplay: off | next_episode | next_in_season_only — advance after an episode ends naturally
_playback.autoplay_countdown_seconds: Seconds before the next episode starts (0 = instant). Esc cancels during countdown. Also used for manual prev/next episode skip.
_playback.episode_skip_double_tap_ms: Double-tap ←/→ within this many ms skips episode (0 = disable double-tap; default 450). Dedicated keys: keymap next_episode / prev_episode (PageDown / PageUp).
_playback.now_playing_splash: Show episode summary before playback starts (default true)
_playback.now_playing_splash_seconds: How long the summary stays on screen (default 1.5; 0 = skip even if enabled)
_playback.hw_decode: auto | on | off — Pi V4L2 hardware H.264 decode (auto = H.264 only on Raspberry Pi)

_cache.enabled: Background-copy remote episodes to local disk for smoother playback (default true)
_cache.max_bytes: LRU cache size cap in bytes (default 2 GiB)
_cache.prefetch_next: Start caching the next autoplay episode during the countdown (default true)
_cache.cache_before_playing: Wait on the now-playing title screen with a progress bar until the episode is fully cached (default false; avoids mid-playback cache switch)

_youtube.playback_mode: DEFAULT prefer_cache (file when present, live Chrome on miss). live = always Chrome; cached_only = block uncached (Pi 1 / Zero)
_youtube.cache.enabled: Download configured channels into a forever tree via yt-dlp (DEFAULT true). Set false to disable fills; live still works on prefer_cache miss. Distinct from playback cache above.
_youtube.cache.directory: Offline tree root (null = first writable media_paths entry; else state dir fallback). Point at NAS for shared Pi fills.
_youtube.cache.max_bytes: Optional soft cap; null = forever (never delete completed files). When set, new downloads are skipped once over budget.
_youtube.cache.download_when_idle: Background fills while browsing/menus/screensaver after idle_seconds without input (paused during PLAYING / Weather / Retro). Priority Y/Enter still runs immediately (unless rate-limited).
_youtube.cache.idle_seconds: Seconds without UI input before background fills start (default 30). Does not affect the screensaver timer; cache progress is not activity.
_youtube.cache.idle_gap_seconds: Pause between background idle batches (default 60). Priority Y/Enter skips this gap.
_youtube.cache.rate_limit_cooldown_seconds: After a bot/429 block, pause ALL cache downloads for this many seconds (default 1800). Escalates on repeat hits up to 6h.
_youtube.cache.exclude_unavailable: When true, hide YouTube episodes marked UNAVAILABLE from browse/play counts (alias: excludeUnavailable). Press Y to clear a skip and retry while they remain visible.
_youtube.cache.format: yt-dlp format string — default prefers ≤480p for the 640×480 canvas (then ≤360, then ≤720)
_youtube.cache.layout: season_folders = Show/s01/S01E01 - Title [id].mp4 (library parity); flat = Show/S01E01 - Title [id].mp4
_youtube.cache.batch_size: Concurrent yt-dlp downloads (1–8, default 1). Raise to 2–4 if YouTube throttles single connections.

_ui.channel_snow: FUN TWEAK — B&W static burst when committing channel numbers on show/season/episode lists (not arrow keys). Pre-cached 320ms animation. CLI: --channel-snow
_ui.shutdown_collapse: FUN TWEAK — CRT vertical collapse on quit. CLI: --shutdown-collapse
_ui.channel_snow_audio: FUN TWEAK — Quiet white-noise with channel snow (defaults on when channel_snow is true; set false to mute)
_ui.analog_artifacts: FUN TWEAK — Random brief static, line tear, and vertical roll on the show browser only. CLI: --analog-artifacts
_ui.analog_artifact_rate: Glitches per minute when analog_artifacts is on (default 12; 0 = no timed glitches)
_ui.footer_hints: Bottom status bar (clock + help key) on browse screens in parent mode (toggle with F5 by default; always off in kids mode)
_ui.marquee_scroll: always = scroll overflowing panel titles continuously; selected = only the highlighted row (legacy)

_safe_zone.top: Overscan padding above the 640×480 UI (% of UI height). Extends the framebuffer outward — UI is never scaled.
_safe_zone.bottom: Padding below the UI (% of UI height — often higher on CRTs, e.g. 8)
_safe_zone.left: Padding left of the UI (% of UI width)
_safe_zone.right: Padding right of the UI (% of UI width)
_safe_zone.offset_x: Optional pixel shift right within the safe area (asymmetric overscan tuning)
_safe_zone.offset_y: Optional pixel shift down within the safe area
_safe_zone.offset: Optional shorthand { "x": N, "y": N } or [x, y] for offset_x/y
_safe_zone.margin: Optional shorthand — uniform %% on all sides (e.g. 5 or {"margin": 5})
_safe_zone.vertical: Optional shorthand for top and bottom together
_safe_zone.horizontal: Optional shorthand for left and right together

_easter_eggs.test_patterns: Any parent browse screen — press 001, 002, or 003 for full-screen colorbars.png, grid.png, indianhead.png from src/tv_time_capsule/assets/ (you supply the PNGs; app never generates them). Esc exits. Bare 0 = Back; 00 = alphabet menu. See docs/usage/fun-tweaks-and-easter-eggs.md

_gamepad: USB controllers via SDL. Remap live in-app with F4 (gamepad configuration). Bindings use readable tokens: button-N, hat-up/down/left/right, stick-up/down/left/right.

_keymap_reference.up: Browse up / volume up during playback (default: Up arrow)
_keymap_reference.down: Browse down / volume down during playback (default: Down arrow)
_keymap_reference.left: Back / seek backward 10s during playback (default: Left arrow)
_keymap_reference.right: Select / seek forward 10s during playback (default: Right arrow)
_keymap_reference.select: Select / play / pause-resume (default: Enter, keypad Enter, Space)
_keymap_reference.quit: Quit app — parent mode only (default: Q)
_keymap_reference.help: Context help for the current screen (default: H)
_keymap_reference.reset: Reset watch status — tap; hold to rescan library (default: R)
_keymap_reference.keymap_reset: Reset all key bindings to defaults on key-setup screen (default: F3)
_keymap_reference.keymap_remove: Remove last binding for highlighted action on key-setup screen (default: Delete)
_keymap_reference.letter_menu: Open alphabet jump menu on show/movie list — parent mode (default: L)
_keymap_reference.kids_tag_toggle: Tag/untag title for kids allowlist — parent mode (default: K)
_keymap_reference.zoom_toggle: Toggle YouTube pillarbox zoom for the current episode (default: T)
_keymap_reference.footer_hints_toggle: Toggle browse status bar — parent mode (default: F5)

_keymap_notes: Each action accepts a key name string or an array of names (aliases). Examples: escape, enter, space, q, f2, up, num-0.
Legacy integer pygame key codes still load correctly.
Omit an action or use an empty keymap object {} to keep defaults.
Rebind in-app with F2. F3 on that screen resets to defaults; Delete removes the last alias.
Left/right on the key-setup screen change pages. Assigning a key already used elsewhere moves it to the new action.
_screensaver: FUN TWEAK — Bouncing VHS logo (vhs.bmp, 2x pixelated) on a black screen after menu idle time. Random multiply tint on each bounce. Any key dismisses.

_mount_fields.type: Required. cifs | smb | nfs | sshfs | sftp | ftp | ftps
_mount_fields.source: Required. Share URL or remote path
_mount_fields.options: Optional. Array of mount options or comma-separated string
_mount_fields.password: Optional. Literal password (discouraged — use keyring or credentials file)
_mount_fields.keyring: Optional. OS keychain item name for the password
_mount_fields.username_keyring: Optional. OS keychain item name for the username
_mount_fields.identity_file: Optional. SSH private key for sshfs

_setup: Development: cp config.example.json config.json  (repo root; auto-discovered)
Remove unused entries from media_paths and delete mount blocks you do not need.
Mountpoints are scanned automatically even if omitted from media_paths.
